description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ConfirmationAndRating" name="Application confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HireIntention" name="Company wants applicant to work for them"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationCompleted" name="Probation completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RatingAndJobStatus" name="Company rating and job status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ConfirmationAndRating" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmationAndRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndRating" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JobOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendJobOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveJobOffer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HireIntention" sourceRef="Task_SendHireIntention" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHireIntention" messageRef="Message_HireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationCompleted" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationCompleted" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationCompleted" messageRef="Message_ProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RatingAndJobStatus" sourceRef="Task_SendRatingAndJobStatus" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRatingAndJobStatus" messageRef="Message_RatingAndJobStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Applicant" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplication" name="Send job application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndRating" name="Receive application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveJobOffer" name="Receive potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewDecision" name="Negotiate an interview?" default="Flow_InterviewNo"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate interview with company"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveHireIntention" name="Receive company's intention to hire" messageRef="Message_HireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Probation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyProbationCompleted" name="Notify company that probation is complete" messageRef="Message_ProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" name="Continue after probation ratings"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitOneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReviewVisible" name="Make company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReviewVisible" name="Company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRatingAndJobStatus" name="Receive company rating and job status" messageRef="Message_RatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingThreshold" name="Did you rate the company C or less?" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Permanent" name="Job is permanent; process ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicantStart_SendApplication" sourceRef="StartEvent_Applicant" targetRef="Task_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendApplication_Report" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_Offer" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_InterviewDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveJobOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewDone" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewMerge_HireIntention" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HireIntention_Probation" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveHireIntention" targetRef="Task_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Probation_Notify" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_RateCompany" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationCompleted" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateCompany_PostProbationSplit" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostProbationSplit_Timer" sourceRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" targetRef="Event_WaitOneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timer_MakeReviewVisible" sourceRef="Event_WaitOneYear" targetRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MakeReviewVisible_End" sourceRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible" targetRef="EndEvent_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostProbationSplit_RatingStatus" sourceRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingStatus_JobPermanent" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRatingAndJobStatus" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCOrLess" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="Task_ReceiveJobOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsCOrLess</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="EndEvent_Permanent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company actions" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyWorkSplit" name="Confirm receipt and rate application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmApplication" name="Confirm receipt of application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyWorkJoin" name="Continue after confirmation and rating"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmationAndRating" name="Send application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendJobOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendHireIntention" name="Tell applicant the company wants them to work there" messageRef="Message_HireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationCompleted" name="Receive probation completion notice" messageRef="Message_ProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineJobStatus" name="Determine whether the job became permanent"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRatingStatusSplit" name="Rate applicant and determine job status"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRatingStatusJoin" name="Continue after rating and status determination"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRatingAndJobStatus" name="Send company rating and job status" messageRef="Message_RatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Company" name="Company actions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyStart_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanySplit_Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfirmApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanySplit_Rate" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_Join" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmApplication" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateApplication_Join" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyJoin_SendConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmation_SendOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmationAndRating" targetRef="Task_SendJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendOffer_SendHireIntention" sourceRef="Task_SendJobOffer" targetRef="Task_SendHireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendHireIntention_ReceiveProbation" sourceRef="Task_SendHireIntention" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveProbation_Split" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingStatusSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanySplit_RateApplicant" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingStatusSplit" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanySplit_DetermineStatus" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingStatusSplit" targetRef="Task_DetermineJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateApplicant_Join" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingStatusJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineStatus_Join" sourceRef="Task_DetermineJobStatus" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingStatusJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRatingStatusJoin_Send" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingStatusJoin" targetRef="Task_SendRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRatingStatus_End" sourceRef="Task_SendRatingAndJobStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
